name: gizza-ai/sql-formatter
summary: Pretty-print and standardize a SQL query's formatting

tool.description: Pretty-print (beautify) and standardize a SQL query — major clauses on their own lines, select-list items one per line, AND/OR broken and indented, function calls kept tight, string literals and comments preserved. indent sets spaces per level (0-8, default 2); keyword_case = upper (default), lower, or preserve. Dialect-agnostic and forgiving. Runs locally.

indent.description: Spaces of indentation per nesting level (0-8, default 2).

keyword_case.description: Casing for SQL keywords: upper (default), lower, or preserve (keep as written).
